verses.text: Ix in na'an wal sik'lab'il, ix laj wak'an prowal b'ajtak tz'ilchaj tzalajk'olal wu'uj, palta haxo ix wilani to malaj b'aj tz'ilchaji.
Ix nachajel wu'uj to ayik sko sayan tas tz'aj ko tzewaji, tob'an manh pensaril jun chi', haxo yik skak'an ko gana kalani, malaj yelk'och jun chi'.

Ix in nib'ej wal ix wojtakejeli tas wal junok niwan yelk'och sko b'o a onh anima onh tik, yakb'an pitzan onh jaye'ok k'uhal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ix wak' wal tzalajb'ok in k'ol yet' uk'el anh, ix wak'anoch in b'a t'a manh pensaril, palta na'annhej wu'uj to a in jelanil tzin kuchb'ani.
Jantak niwak munlajel ix in b'o'o. Ix in b'o juntzanh pat, ix laj wawanpax te' uwa.
Ix laj in b'o b'ajtak tz'awchaj te' awb'en te' yet' b'ajtak tz'awchaj te te' syak' xumakil. Ix wawanpax masanil makanhil te te' syak' sat.
Ix laj in b'oanpax yet'tal ha ha' b'aj smolchaji yik tz'och yal te' awb'en te' chi'.

Ay heb' winh in chekab' yet' heb' ix in chekab' ix in mana', ay pax heb' ix alji t'a in pat. Hanhejtona' jantak pax ix aj nok' in wakax yet' nok' in kalnel t'a yichanh heb' ek'nak kajan t'a Jerusalén t'a pekataxo.

Manhxo jantakok k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro ix in molb'ej, haton k'e'en kotnak t'a heb' sreyal juntzanhxo nación. Ay pax heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itan t'ayin, haton masanil nib'ab'il yuj heb' ketanima'il. Jantak pax heb' ix ix, ix wik'a', tzolal sjawi heb' ix t'ayin.
Ix in b'inaj wal t'a yichanh masanil heb' ek'nak t'a Jerusalén tik. Wach'chom ay masanil juntzanh tik t'ayin, palta maj satel-laj in jelanil.
Maj in tenek'laj tas ix in nib'ej. Ix wak'nhej in gana yet' tas ix in na'a. Ix wak' tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol yet' masanil in munlajel, haton jun tzalajk'olal chi' ix ak'ji spakok t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wilanoch masanil in munlajel ix in b'o chi', haton juntzanh munlajel chi' pural ix b'o wu'uj. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel wu'uj to a masanil juntzanh chi', malaj yelk'ochi. Lajan wal icha b'aj sko nib'ej sko yam ik', palta max yamchajlaj ku'uj. Icha chi' kaji, malaj jab'ok tas wach' skik' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in na'anpaxi tas wal yaj jelanil, manh pensaril yet' kistalil. ¿Tasto wal ol sk'ulej junokxo mach ol ochkan reyal in k'exulok? ¿Tokwal ay junokxo tas ch'ok ol yal sna'anelta sb'o'ani mato sk'ulani?
Icha chi' ix aj snachajel wu'uj to a jelanil yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh manh pensaril, icha yaj sakil k'inal te wach' t'a yichanh k'ik' k'inal.
Ha mach nhikan spensar, te wach' yilan b'aj tz'ek'i. Haxo mach malaj spensar jun, ichato t'a skal k'ik' k'inal sb'eyek'i. Wach'chom icha chi', palta lajannhej tz'aj ko chami.
Ix walan icha tik: Ha tas ol ik'an heb' malaj spensar, hanheja' ol in ik'an paxok, yuj chi' jun, malaj jab'ok tas skik' t'a jelanil chi'. Hanheja' malaj yelk'och juntzanh chi'.
Yuj chi' wach'chom jelan onh, wach'chom malaj ko pensar, ol onh cham ko masanil, manhxo ol onh nachajkot yuj anima.

Yuj chi' ix in na icha tik, malaj yelk'och ko k 'inal tik, yujto masanil tas sko k'ulej t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, tonhej skixtej ko b'a yuj. Lajan wal icha b'aj sko nib'ej sko yam ik', palta max yamchajlaj ku'uj, icha chi' kaji.
Hanhejtona' malaj yelk'och masanil juntzanh in munlajel ix in b'o t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto masanil juntzanh chi' anhej am t'a junokxo mach b'aj ol kanok.
Taxonhej jelan, ma malaj spensar jun b'aj ol kan masanil in munlajel ix wab' sya'il in b'oan chi' yet' jelanil, malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ayik swilanoch masanil in munlajel ix in b'o chi', sna'an sb'a in k'o'ol to nab'anhej ix wixtej in b'a in te munlaji.
Ay b'aj jelan ko b'oan ko munlajel chi', te wach' skutej yuj tastak kojtak, palta haxo tz'aji ha t'a junok max munlaj jab'ok, hata' skani. Ha jun chi' nab'anhej, manh smojok icha chi'.
Yuj chi', ¿tas wal skak' yala' ayik te niwan munlajel sko b'o yet' jantak tas sko na' yuj?
Masanil tiempo sko te naub'tanhej, al yajoch t'a kib'anh icha wal junok ikatz. Max yik' jab'ok yip ko pensar, yuj chi' malaj yelk'och jun chi'.

Ha wal tas smoj sko k'ulej a onh anima onh tik to tzonh wa'i skuk'an ha', skak'an tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol yet' tastak skik' t'a ko munlajel chi'. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel wu'uj to a jun chi' a t'a Dios skoti.
¿Tom syal ko tzalaji, ma ko wa'i tato manh yujok Dios?

Tato stzalaj Dios ket'ok, syak' ko jelanil yet' ko pensar yet' ko tzalajk'olal. Palta haxo heb' chuk jun, ha Dios chi' tz'ak'an yip heb' yik smunlaj heb' smolb'an tastak tz'aj t'a heb', haxo tz'aji, ha t'a heb' stzalaj Dios yet'ok chi' skani. Palta a jun tik nab'anhejpaxi, lajan wal icha b'aj sko nib'ej sko yam ik', palta max yamchajlaj ku'uj.
